summary: The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities included in its index, in depositary receipts representing securities included in the index and in underlying stocks in respect of depositary receipts included in its index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity securities of small capitalization U.S. issuers.
